text_run.content: This operation inserts or updates data in a specific collection.

milvusClient.upsert({
   db_name: string,
   collection_name: string,
   data: RowData[],
   hash_keys: Number[],
   partial_update: boolean,
   partition_name: string,
   timeout: number
The name of the database that holds the target collection.
The name of an existing collection.
The data to insert into the current collection.
The data to insert should be a dictionary that matches the schema of the current collection or a list of such dictionaries.
To perform an update, you are advised first to retrieve the target entity from the collection, modify the values of any relevant fields, and then save it back to the collection.
The following code assumes that the schema of the current collection has three fields named
field is the primary field, the
field is a field to hold 5-dimensional vector embeddings, and the
field is a scalar field holding strings.
The timeout duration for this operation.
indicates that this operation timeouts when any response arrives or any error occurs.
Whether to enable partial update. Once set to
, you can include only the fields that need updating in
The name of a partition in the current collection.
If specified, the data is to be inserted into the specified partition.
